You’re a seed stuck in the ground.

description.en: On the day of my wedding, I found out that my lover was cheating on me with my best friend. I died because of their betrayal, and when I opened my eyes again, I returned to the past. I thought this was a blessing from God, a chance to take revenge. But this return was neverending as I kept dying either from their betrayal or in an accident. After my repeated death, I realized that accidents did not cause all of my deaths but that I was being murdered. So this time, I faked my death and left everything behind to catch the murderer, who was killing me repeatedly and to take my revenge finally.

His hometown which he hastily returned to seemed foreign. He barely managed to have a funeral for his family when the fatigue and stress made him faint. When he woke up...

**{ Hello Master. It’s nice to meet you! ^o^ I am the cute spirit GM who will help you with <Otherworldly Adventures!> and <Joyful Territory Management!> full of Master’s dreams. I am so happy to be with you from now on. Hurray! Could you name me before starting? ☞ Insert Name __ }**

This is a quest to level up, no matter how I look at it, even the notification windows look like the game UIs of the previous life.

It made me recall the games I used to play, so I decided to work hard on my quests. I even looked around the estate.
However, that manor...

*“There’s only 234 days left until doom...?”*
Alright, let’s start with the succession ceremony. I’m sure everything will work out.

The Grand General of Cheon Won-guk gets proposed to by the troublemaker prince?  
The head of the illustrious family that has held military power in Cheon Won-guk for generations, Hwang Bo Ikseon is a talented Grand General that wins every battle she fights. During a party to celebrate Ikseon’s victory, the Emperor mentions an engagement to the prince, but Ikseon rejects him immediately. However, at the peak of the party, Prince Unha, often called the headache of the imperial family, strikes. Unha tells Ikseon that he fell for her, begging her to marry him, and even goes to announce that he will become her concubine.  
“I, Prince Unha, announce that from this moment onwards, I will become Grand General Ikseon’s concubine.”

description.en: Mysterious black towers have appeared all over the world. Inside them are monsters, danger, and the promise of power and fame. Only a select few are chosen to enter as players. Everyone calls it a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, but 25-year-old Juhyeok Bong calls it a death sentence. He is a timid, anxious self-proclaimed “wimp,” perfectly content with staying under the radar… That is, until he is named as a player. Will he risk everything by entering the tower, or keep running from the one chance that could change his life?
description.pt-br:
O mundo mudou com o aparecimento das Torres Negras e dos “Despertos”, mas a vida de Bong Juhyeok continuava a mesma: tímida, insegura e exaustiva. Ele achava que aquele novo mundo não era para ele.
Mas tudo muda no momento em que ele se prepara para comer um simples macarrão instantâneo. Uma mensagem do sistema surge, anunciando o impossível: ele despertou. Agora, arrancado de sua mediocridade, Juhyeok precisa descobrir se esse poder é a salvação que ele esperava ou um passaporte para um desastre ainda maior.

description.en: Go Baekhee had a hard time carrying her head when she was the main character of the "Storm Strong Kick" meme. In order to leave Korea, she will get a fake marriage on the premise of getting divorced with Hangyul, a permanent resident of Australia. However, to be accepted, one must prove the "true love" between the two. What is true love? True love is not easy. And it's also not easy to keep a relationship undiscovered which is a fraud itself!

Why do we keep bumping into each other? A college youth foodie's romance!  
  
Mukbang & daily life combination:  
It's better to eat together than eat alone!

In the frontier of the American West, a veil of evil threatens to engulf humanity. Servants of the fallen archangel Temozarela are paving the way for their dark lord's resurrection. One man stands in the way of the apocalypse: Ivan Isaacs, a fallen priest who sold his soul to the devil Belial for the power to fight evil. Armed with a wicked blade and silver bullets, Ivan will give the heretics a baptism of blood in his pilgrimage for humanity's redemption.

Jang Jinmyeong, a martial arts master who mastered the forbidden technique“Gyuhwa Bojeon, reached the peak of power — only to be branded a traitor and thrown off a cliff.

Just before his death, he realizes two grave mistakes:

1. He gained immense power through Gyuhwa Bojeon at the cost of losing his manhood.
2. He failed to eliminate the vile traitors Wang Jin and Seop Pyeong when he had the chance.

But instead of dying, Jinmyeong awakens in a mysterious realm, where he encounters the original copy of Gyuhwa Bojeon , and is sent 32 years back in time — right before he lost his manhood.

Now, with his body intact and the power of Gyuhwa Bojeon still coursing through him, Jinmyeong embarks on a new path.

This time, he will correct the regrets of his past life… and seek vengeance against Wang Jin and Seop Pyeong, the men who betrayed him.

Adriana is a beautiful princess who was called the flower of society and that she was the incarnation of a fairy. Having met a man she loved and dreamed of a happy life with, she was caught up in a conspiracy and lost her family, and faced a miserable death by her husband’s affair partner. She then felt a great sense of freedom that this pain was finally over. She realised that she was back in the past, 8 years ago to be exact. “I can’t repeat that miserable life again!“ In order to uncover the conspiracy surrounding her family's deaths, Adriana hides her identity and sneaks into a bank owned by her family. Will Adriana be able to live happily in this life?

description.en:
“Who’s this male prostitute-looking kid?” I am the Matchless Ha Hoo Young, the greatest martial artist reigning over all the lands! There is no one that is my equal! I was drowning in futility and emptiness because there was no more that I could accomplish in the human realm. To reach the peak of martial arts, I must become a saint! “I finally succeeded!!!” “Stop! Your ascension is not permitted!” The other saints refused my ascension due to my karma after much slaughter, and I fell, just like that.
When I woke up, I was 60 years in the future. I was reborn as the second lord of the Namgoong family, Namgoong Hyuk. Where has all the internal energy that I’ve accumulated gone?! Moreover, I have the Nine yin energy blockage?

천하제일로 군림하던 최강의 무인! 나, 독패 하후영.
나를 상대할 자는 무림 어디에도 존재하지 않는다!

무의 끝, 극의를 이루기 위해서는 신선이 될 수밖에!

description.en:
A noblewoman preparing for a political marriage keeps fainting in terror whenever she meets her intimidating fiancé—but he mistakes her fear for affection. Determined to call off the engagement, she must navigate his unexpected romanticism and family secrets.
___
Grace Oelin, plagued by a fear of sharp objects, faints whenever she meets Lucas Black, the kingdom’s most feared, sword-wielding duke. But beneath his cold exterior lies a hopeless romantic. Determined to break off their arranged marriage, Grace is horrified to learn Lucas has mistaken her fear for love. As he dreams of a sweet newlywed life, Grace plots her escape. Can she see past his fearsome image and discover who he truly is, or will the secrets of the infamous House Black pull her under?
description.id: Lucas Black—Duke tampan, penuh wibawa, dan... sedikit bikin merinding. Di mata semua orang, dia sosok sempurna. Lucas Black juga memiliki rahasia besar sehingga ia berharap calon istrinya dapat merahasiakan dan menerima nya. Tapi di mata Grace, tunangan politiknya, dia adalah mimpi buruk berkaki dua. Setiap kali berhadapan dengan Lucas, jantung Grace berdebar kencang—bukan karena cinta, tapi karena takut. Sampai-sampai ia berkali-kali pingsan. Masalahnya? Lucas justru mengira Grace sedang mabuk kepayang. Ia percaya calon istrinya terlalu bahagia setiap kali mereka bertemu, dan sudah membayangkan kehidupan pernikahan yang manis bersamanya. Sementara itu, Grace hanya ingin satu hal: membatalkan pertunangan ini dengan aman, cepat. Bisakah Grace menyelamatkan diri dari cinta sepihak yang menyeramkan ini—sebelum Lucas mulai memilih gaun pengantin atau malah menjalin romansa tak terduga dengan Duke Lucas Black?

Cela ne le dérange pas d’encourager Chanyoung en étant qu’un spectateur ou bien d’écouter tous ses problèmes de fille. Il s’en fiche que les gens le considèrent comme seulement son « ami ». Cependant un jour Heesu commence à entendre son nom de partout : dans le bus, dans le hall et même pendant la pause de midi ? Une rumeur circule dans l’école : Vous avez un problème ? Trouvez Heesu dans la Classe 2 et il vous dira que faire ! Heesu se retrouve soudainement au centre de l’attention. Mais comment il peut conseiller quelqu’un alors qu’il sait pas quoi faire pour son propre amour.

Tomber amoureux devrait être une expérience excitante... mais pas pour Hari ! Notre héroïne est maudite par l'amour non réciproque, et Yura compte bien en profiter. Hari réussira-t-elle à avouer ses sentiments à son premier amour, ou se laissera-t-elle emporter par les complications de cet amour non partagé ? Son histoire d'amour passionnante est sur le point de commencer.

description.en: Jungho is bullied to the point of self-harm, until one day, his prayers are answered by Mephistopheles, the archdevil. Mephisto offers Jungho magical powers that would allow him to take revenge on his bullies, and in return, asks for his soul. It's an easy choice for Jungho, who thinks nothing can be worse than the living hell that is his life. But what he doesn't know is that there are greater forces at work, and that he is but a pawn in a much larger game played by angels, demons, and exorcists.

description.en:
Our Protagonist was an avid gamer, obsessed with a fantasy game with multiple outcomes for its Female Lead.
After meeting her untimely demise, she was reborn into the game as Remilian, the daughter of the Female Lead.

Her extensive knowledge of the game was no longer any good, as she was born after the game's worst ending had already occurred.
Now stuck with a tragic story, unable to change anything following the ""Bad Ending"", she is content with her small but happy life with her loving mother, the original Female Lead, even though they are imprisoned by the King, Remilian's actual father.
Following an attempt at escape, Remilian finds herself on the brink of dying again, but a last moment spell from her mother throws her back into the past.

Waking up in a timeline before the game's events have unfolded, Remilian now has all the knowledge she needs to make a choice:
Will she change her mother's tragic ending, even at the cost of never being born?

*Note: The adaptation was made in Japanese, not in Korean, by Pocket Comic (like always), with korean authors/artist. That's why there is no Korean cover for the Manhwa.*

description.de: In einem Buch aufzuwachen ist nichts Neues, aber in der Hochzeitsnacht vom eigenen Buch-Ehemann ermordet zu werden, irgendwie schon. In der Hoffnung, diesem Schicksal zu entgehen, heiratet Enrica statt dem Erzherzog einen mysteriösen Grafen. Alles scheint gut zu laufen – selbst ihr machthungriger Vater stimmt der Heirat zu und der verschmähte Erzherzog schreitet ebenfalls nicht ein. Aber je mehr Enrica darüber nachdenkt, desto verdächtiger wirkt das Ganze. Woher kam ihr perfekter Graf so plötzlich? Und laufen die Dinge nicht ein wenig zu gut?
description.en:
How is the reincarnated heroine supposed to survive as Enrica, a powerless noble lady who gets killed by her archduke husband on her wedding night? 

Fortunately, a mysterious but kind Count Belbrington hears Enrica's plight, suggests that she find another man to marry, and even says yes to her following proposal! Everything seems strangely smooth sailing from there. 

Not only is Enrica's power-hungry father surprisingly cool with her marrying a man of lower status, but the murderous archduke isn't retaliating at her for breaking off their engagement, either. 

Something's not adding up, but what could it be...?
description.fr: Réincarnée dans le corps d'Enrica, une noble demoiselle condamnée à être tuée par son mari, l’archiduc, notre héroïne doit lutter pour échapper à ce destin inévitable. Heureusement, le comte Belbrington, un homme aussi énigmatique que bienveillant, vient à son secours. Non seulement il lui conseille de fuir ce destin funeste en choisissant un autre époux… mais il accepte aussi sa proposition de mariage! Tout semble cependant trop beau pour être vrai. Son père, habituellement avide de pouvoir, ne s’oppose pas à son union avec un homme de statut inférieur, et l’archiduc, loin de chercher à se venger, reste étrangement silencieux. Quelque chose cloche, mais que peut-il bien se cacher derrière cette apparente et inquiétante tranquillité?
description.ja: 目が覚めると結婚初夜に夫に殺される花嫁、エンリカ・ウィンターソアになっていた。同じ運命を繰り返さないためには、大公と結婚破棄するしかない!そんなエンリカの前に出番のないエキストラ、ベルブリントン伯爵が現れる。最初は怪しいと思ったが…彼の提案が悪くない!「方法がないわけではありません。その婚約者ではなく、別の男と…結婚すればいいのですから」しかし、今すぐ私と結婚してくれる相手がいるわけ…「伯爵様、私と結婚してくれませんか?」断られると思いきや、伯爵はすんなり承諾してくれた。…本当に?こんなに簡単に…!?
description.ko:
결혼 첫날밤 악역 대공 남편에게 살해당하는 인물,
'엔리카 윈터소어'의 몸에 빙의했다.

끔찍한 죽음을 피할 방법은 우선 대공과의 결혼을 무산시키는 것뿐.

"방법이 있습니다, 엔리."

물러날 곳이 없던 엔리카에게 성큼 다가온 한 남자.
그는 자신을 '카엘 벨브링턴 백작'이라 소개한다.

원작에 이런 인물이 있었던가 하는 고민도 잠시,

"정혼자가 아닌 다른 남자와…
결혼하면 되지 않겠습니까."

그가 꺼내든 묘책이 나쁘지 않다!
하지만 결혼할 남자를 당장 어디서 찾지?

"백작님, 저랑 결혼하실래요?"

밑져야 본전, 눈앞의 남자에게 청혼했는데…

"좋습니다. 그 말을 기다리고 있었습니다."

…꼼짝없이 죽을 거라 생각했는데,
일이 이렇게 쉽게 풀려도 되는 걸까?

description.en:
Next to impossible coincidences seem to be connected to a shared dream… Is this destiny?  
Chayee springs out of bed after one of the most realistic and steamy dreams she’s ever had. After bringing herself back to reality, she goes to work as a T.A. at her former university. But, while on an errand for her professor, she meets Dohun and gets the shock of her life. He… seriously resembles the man she spent a hot night in the dream. She finds herself unable to face him since every glance brings back the very realistic feelings of the night before!  
“By any chance, have we… met before?”  
Dohun also has unexplainable feelings of discomfort towards Chayee and puts as much space between them as he can. But, no matter how hard they try, fate keeps dragging them back towards each other. What’s going on?! When dreams and reality intertwine, anything can happen!

description.pl:
Wydaje się, że niemożliwe zbiegi okoliczności łączy wspólny sen. Czy to może być przeznaczenie? 

Chayee zrywa się z łóżka po jednym z najbardziej realistycznych i gorących snów, jakie kiedykolwiek miała. Po powróceniu do rzeczywistości bohaterka wraca do pracy jako zwykła asystentka swojego profesora na jej byłym uniwersytecie. Wykonując zadania dla swojego profesora, spotyka Dohuna i przeżywa szok swojego życia. On... bardzo przypomina mężczyznę, z którym spędziła gorącą noc we śnie. Nie może stawić mu czoła, ponieważ każde przypadkowe spojrzenie przywołuje bardzo realistyczne uczucia z poprzedniego wieczoru.
"Czy my się już przypadkiem nie spotkaliśmy?" 

Dohuna również ma niewytłumaczalne uczucie dyskomfortu w stosunku do Chayee, dlatego postanawia trzymać się na dystans. Ale bez względu na to, jak bardzo się starają, los ciągnie ich z powrotem do siebie. 

Co się dzieje? 
Kiedy sny i rzeczywistość zaczną się przeplatać, wszystko może się wydarzyć!

description.en:
After the ruin of an aristocratic family in England, Eva Macy has been living a difficult life as a maid at an acquaintance’s house, where she happens to meet her ex-fiancé Prince Edward.

Despite being a strong and cold-hearted person, he is affectionate towards her. After he leaves, Eva realizes that he’s her first love. However, she decides to give up on her current feelings, believing it to be in her best interest to do so.

After overcoming such a difficult time, Eva's feelings for Edward calmed down, but one day, Edward suddenly appeared before her as if to stir up Eva’s heart again.

Eva becomes a chambermaid for her ex-fiancé Edward, where he constantly tries to seduce Eva.

The relationship she thought had ended a long time ago continues again in his chambers...

Roa Coatl is on a mission. He must find the descendant of Quetzalcoatl to make her his wife and continue his great race of dragons for 'that day'. However, with no knowledge about love and having no interest in women, will he be able to accomplish his task in human world?

In a world where warriors are chosen to wield a holy sword and defeat the Demon Lord every hundred years, Kariel is only a guide, bound to support others from the sidelines. He dreams of rising beyond his rank, but the Demon Lord of this era has already been slain. 

Despite this, the world begins to unravel instead of heal. Monsters grow unpredictable, a mysterious knight hunts champions, and secret organizations move in the shadows. 

Traveling with his childhood friend Reina, Kariel is drawn into a dangerous mystery that may determine the fate of the world.

Xion was rescued with lost memory from a village that was terribly slaughtered when he was young.

While living as an apprentice priest in a neighborhood chapel hoping to live a peaceful life, he accidently saved the pontifex (high priest), Parvellone, with his favor, Xion was ascended to Zion, the capital of the Holy Kingdom.

Xion was captured in a dungeon for possessing ‘something he shouldn’t have’ and tortured by the Holy King, Siennas, then Xion died after discovering he was betrayed by Parvellone, whom he believed.

어린 시절 끔찍하게 학살당한 마을에서 기억을 잃은 채 구조된 시온.
굴곡 없는 삶을 살길 희망하며 이웃 마을 신전의 견습 신관으로 지내던 중, 우연히 대신관 파르벨로네를 구해 주고 그의 호의로 성국의 수도 제온에 올라가게 된다.

그로부터 5년 뒤.
시온은 ‘가져서는 안 될 것’을 가지고 있다는 이유로 지하 감옥에 갇혀 성왕 시에나스에게 모진 고문을 받고, 믿었던 파르벨로네에게 배신을 당했다는 사실을 알게 된 뒤 숨을 거둔다.

그러나 다음 순간 시온은 5년 전 성왕의 즉위식 날, 다름 아닌 시에나스의 몸에서 눈을 뜨게 되는데….

After overcoming a miserable life, she entered the university with an excitement. Dabom, who have million of dreams and desires for university, encountered a villain from her very first day... And it's somewhat awkward/unfitting from the start! "Would my campus life be okay this way?!"

title.en: I Became the Black Swan Mother of the White Swan Princess

description.en:
The transmigration that happened to others happened to me, too. I’m pretty sure I’m now a supporting character… but exactly which novel is this?

When I opened my eyes, I was a widow with stepdaughters my own age, and not only that, I turned into a black swan every night due to a dark curse! Holding back my tears, I decided to take charge of my fate…wait, why should I? Why So Serious?

A duchess during the day, a queen of the lake during the night – I have the best luck to be able to leisurely float around! Life should be lived unplanned! When I had just about decided to live my life like this, a white baby swan, one that was not in my no-plan life plan, came to me.

“Mommy, are you really my mommy?”

What, you were a person? And even the youngest sibling of the tyrant emperor?

“I’m not your mother! Can’t you tell by the different colors of our feathers?”

I’m a black swan, you’re a white swan! But why is she so crazy cute. Can our mother-daughter love endure the obsession and persecution of this child’s seven brothers, including the tyrant emperors?

description.en:
The moment my engagement with my human trash fiancé was broken off, memories from my past life returned. I was formerly a hardworking agriculture researcher and a woman who went to farming college! After getting chased out of my family, I decided to stick to my strengths and live a worry-free and comfortable life while farming, but...

"That's my sword."
"No, it's my hoe?"
"It's my sword!"
"I told you, it's my hoe!"

Suddenly, a beautiful blond man—who looked perfectly fine on the outside—appeared to take the hoe I picked up from the ground away from me! This is the start of a farming romance where we'll meet our loved ones as well as pick mulberries (kill two birds with one stone)~

biography.en: Hello, I'm a romance writer from Korea who loves stories with a happy ending! I prefer dogs over cats, and I only drink iced latte, even in the dead of winter!
